control_name: Control-deficiency remediation is tracked to closure with owner and due date
control_objective: Every open control-deficiency remediation item is tracked in the issue system with an accountable owner, a priority, and a committed due date, and none are overdue, so that identified ICFR weaknesses are demonstrably driven to closure.
risk_addressed: Control deficiencies that are not assigned, prioritized, and date-bound are not reliably remediated, allowing ICFR weaknesses to persist undetected across reporting periods.

required_data_elements.business_definition: An open issue tracking remediation of a control deficiency.
The accountable owner of the remediation item.

method.summary: Pull all open remediation items from the tracker and confirm each has an owner, a priority, and a due date, and that none are past due.
steps: List open (non-completed, non-canceled) remediation items via the Linear MCP.
Count items missing an owner, a priority, or a due date.
Count items whose due date has passed.
Fail if any required attribute is missing or any item is overdue.
method.fallback_logic: If the tracker is unreachable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any untracked or overdue remediation item is a control-monitoring exception.

pass_criteria: Every open remediation item has an owner and a due date.
fail_criteria: Any open item lacks an owner or due date.
exception_handling: Assign an owner and due date.
Escalate overdue items to the Controller.

assertions.description: Every open remediation item has an accountable owner.
Every open remediation item has a committed due date.
Every open remediation item is prioritized.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Re-evidenced monthly; feeds the quarterly §404 assessment.

actions_on_fail: Notify SOX Program Manager and Controller
